detail.longDescription:
Create a personal AI assistant in minutes and use it to simplify everyday tasks, content development, planning, and routine workflows.

Zelqora Core lets you customize your own AI agent, choose a name, and start interacting immediately. Ask questions, explore new ideas, prepare drafts, structure tasks, organize workflows, and manage generated responses from one convenient interface.

With Zelqora Core, you can:

- Create a personal AI assistant in just a few steps
- Choose a name and personalize your assistant
- Chat with AI for tips, ideas, and answers
- Generate content for work, learning, and personal use
- Create simple workflows, checklists, and action plans
- Copy, share, regenerate, or delete responses
- Prepare schedules, emails, scripts, to-do lists, and much more

Zelqora Core is designed for users who need practical support for productivity, writing, planning, brainstorming, and daily organization.

This app contains in-app purchases:

Subscription Terms:

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account upon confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current subscription period.

You will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the active billing period. The applicable renewal price will be displayed before payment is processed.

You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your App Store account settings. Where applicable, any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited when you purchase a paid subscription.

All refund requests are reviewed and processed by Apple through the user's App Store account.
